Name: Dialogue UI Unboxed - Immersive Dialogue Speech Bubbles
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][size=6]Dialogue UI Unboxed[/size][/center]
[center][i]Conversations, brought into the world.[/i][/center]
[center][i]Same familiar characters. Same wonderful stories. Just a different way to experience them.[/i][/center]

[center]Ever wished Stardew Valley's characters could speak a little more naturally, instead of having every conversation tucked away in that familiar box at the bottom of the screen?[/center]

[center][color=#f1c232][size=1][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b]
[b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b]
[b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/size][/color][/center]



[b]Dialogue UI Unboxed[/b] brings conversations into the world through cozy pixel-art speech bubbles that appear around the characters themselves. The dialogue becomes part of the scene instead of sitting separately from it.


[b]❤️ Relationship Status - ( New in V1.1.2) [/b]
A little touch of colour that reflects how close you've become with the villagers!
The small dialogue continuation arrow gently glows according to your friendship level.

The effect is subtle, so it doesn't distract from conversations.


[b]👨‍🌾 Farmer Portraits👩‍🌾 - (New in V1.1.2)  [/b]
Your Farmer can finally appear alongside their own dialogue!
Farmer portraits now appear during supported dialogue choices and Farmer-spoken responses, including events, conversations and dialogue history.

[b]Example Farmer portraits are included[/b], featuring a default appearance and seasonal variations.
Since everyone's Farmer looks different, [b]Farmer Portraits are OFF by default[/b].
To enable them:
[list=1]
[*]Open Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).[/*]
[*]Select Dialogue UI Unboxed.[/*]
[*]Turn ON [b]Enable Farmer Portraits[/b].[/*]
[/list]That's it!
You can also use your own artwork instead of the included portraits.
How to Use Custom Farmer Portraits
Open the
[code]Farmer Portrait[/code]folder inside your
[code]DialogueUnboxed[/code]mod folder.

Replace the included PNG images with your own, keeping the same filenames:
[list]
[*][code]Farmer.png[/code]- Default portrait[/*]
[*][code]FarmerSpring.png[/code]- Spring[/*]
[*][code]FarmerSummer.png[/code]- Summer[/*]
[*][code]FarmerFall.png[/code]- Fall[/*]
[*][code]FarmerWinter.png[/code]- Winter[/*]
[/list][b]Recommended size: 256 × 256 pixels[/b], with a transparent background.
The mod automatically uses the portrait for the current season. If a seasonal portrait isn't available, it uses
[code]Farmer.png[/code]Want the same portrait all year? Just use
[code]Farmer.png[/code]You can switch Farmer Portraits ON or OFF in GMCM at any time. Your portrait files won't be deleted or modified.
[color=#999999][size=1]No additional portrait framework is required.[/size][/color]

🎳 [b]Dialogue Font Size (New in V1.1.)[/b]
Make dialogue easier to read with a new 50%–150% font size slider.
NPC names, farmer names and dialogue text now resize together, with nameplates automatically adjusting to keep everything looking tidy.
This also improves font-size flexibility for players using different languages.


[b]✨ Native HD Portrait Support  (New in V1.1.)[/b]
HD portraits are now supported directly by Dialogue UI Unboxed, with a built-in HD portrait system.

[list]
[*]Simply place compatible HD portrait PNGs inside: /DialogueUnboxed/Portraits/[/*]
[/list]You can even organise your PNGs into separate folders. Unboxed automatically searches through them and matches portraits to their corresponding game assets.

If a matching HD portrait is missing or incompatible, the original portrait is displayed instead.

HD portrait artwork is not included. Download compatible portraits separately from their original creators.

👥 [b]A Lovely Companion To GROUP CHAT[/b]
One of my favourite combinations is using Dialogue UI Unboxed with my other mod, Group Chat.
Group Chat allows nearby eligible villagers to join a conversation.

With Dialogue UI Unboxed, those conversations can appear right beside the characters, with the previous speaker's dialogue softly remaining in the scene.

It makes those little group conversations feel even more alive!
Group Chat is completely optional. Dialogue UI Unboxed works on its own.


💬 [b]WHY DIALOGUE UI UNBOXED[/b]
I've always loved the little conversations happening around Stardew Valley.
But sometimes, especially during heart events or conversations with several NPCs, I found myself looking down at the dialogue box instead of watching what was happening in the scene.

And that got me thinking.

What if the characters could actually speak where they're standing?
What if two villagers talking to each other felt like a little conversation happening right in front of you?
And what if your farmer could answer them in the same way?
That's where Dialogue UI Unboxed came from.

I wanted something cozy, simple and natural. Little speech bubbles that belong in Stardew Valley's world without taking away the charm of the original game.

Nothing about the story needs to change.
Just the way we see those conversations.



📦 REQUIREMENTS & INSTALLATION
Requirements
• Stardew Valley 1.6.15 (verified)
• SMAPI 4.5.0 or newer (tested with 4.5.2)
• Generic Mod Config Menu - Optional, recommended for easy configuration
Installation
1. Install SMAPI if you haven't already.
2. Download Dialogue UI Unboxed.
3. Extract the DialogueUnboxed folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
That's it! Your conversations are ready to be unboxed.

💡 COMPATIBILITY
Dialogue UI Unboxed is a standalone mod. It doesn't require any of my other mods to work.
It uses Stardew Valley's existing dialogue, portraits and response systems, preserving the original dialogue text, choices and gameplay consequences.
It has been playtested with vanilla NPCs, modded NPCs, scripted events, Group Chat and a large mod collection.
A few things worth knowing:
• Mods that completely replace Stardew Valley's dialogue interface may conflict.
• Some special interfaces, narration, telephone conversations, black-screen transitions and unsupported dialogue menus intentionally keep their vanilla presentation.
• The mod uses your current portrait textures, so compatible portrait replacements can appear in the speech bubbles.
• Dialogue content expansions can continue providing their own conversations through the game's dialogue system.
Everyone's mod collection is a little different, so I can't promise every custom interface or unusual scripted event will work perfectly.
If something looks strange or a conversation doesn't behave as expected, feel free to report it!

🤖 AI DISCLOSURE
Dialogue UI Unboxed was conceived, designed, directed, gameplay-tested and approved by me.
Generative AI tools assisted with programming and the production of original visual assets, following the designs and visual direction I developed and approved.
The released mod does not run an AI model or require an online AI service during gameplay.
Dialogue presentation, positioning, animations and response handling are performed through the mod's programmed systems.
The mod does not generate conversations or rewrite the dialogue created by Stardew Valley or other mod authors.
